technical.summary: AVGO shows bullish MACD crossovers and long-term uptrend structure, but weak trend strength (ADX 21), stochrsi overbought conditions, and volume divergence limit swing entry conviction.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD crossovers (12/26/9 and 8/21/5) with 50/200 SMA bullish alignment provide technical structure, and broad market fear (44/100) creates contrarian opportunity for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, strong USD, FOMC event in 1 day), fundamental conviction is absent (no insider/institutional support, high earnings risk in 72 days), and stochrsi overbought with volume divergence signal momentum exhaustion into headwinds.
